title: orch pending input v1 (one line of .orch/run/pending/<ticket id>.jsonl)
description: Input for a ticket whose agent is busy, appended under the ticket lock. Live runs get it pasted when idle; oneshot runs get one more (resume) turn with what is left. Delivery is at-least-once, deduped by id, and survives a crash: delivered_at is set only after delivery. Gitignored.

id.description: Random, unique per line; the dedupe key.

by.description: Free actor name, as in run.by.

via.description: Optional free word: the surface it came from.

text.description: What the agent is told, plain text.

delivered_at.description: Set once the agent got it.

human.description: Optional. True when a person wrote it (the owner on a page, the CLI or the phone); false for an agent's (agent:*, or written from inside an agent). Only a person's input may make a background host start a run. Absent (older lines): human when by starts with human: or via is phone.
